notes.title: 3.0.0-bugfix-20230731
notes.notes: Fix some unclickable UI when using Valve Index.

notes.title: 3.0.0-bugfix-20230314
notes.notes: Change the grip action of the valve index controller to trigger, and make it can use the trigger when griping.

notes.title: 3.0.0-bugfix-20230203
notes.notes: Increase the grip threshold for the valve index controller, which is used to lower the possibility of the invalid trigger when griping; Valve Index users may need to relax other fingers while pressing the trigger to avoid triggering the grip.

notes.title: 3.0.0-bugfix-20230106
notes.notes: - Fixed the bug which may not set the decoding API properly on the settings page (DirectShow, MediaFoundation, or Auto)

notes.title: Moon VR Update: External Subtitles and DLAN Supported!
notes.notes:
Dear all,
Moon VR is constantly working to improve your experience with us.
Here is what’s new in our latest version on Steam:

[Features]

 Brand new UI and UX, easier and simpler to use!
 Brand new homepage environment
 More kinds of 3D video and screen mode supported: Youtube, Fisheye and so on
 Better screen grabbing and adjustment function
 Better subtitle function
 DLNA supported!
 Automatic recognition of video playback mode based on file name


We do look forward to your feedback!
Feel free to join us on Discord, or send your suggestions or issues to support@moonvrplayer.com
Thank you for your support!
Moon VR
p.s. Just in case you still wish to install the older version, please find [legacy-legacy channel] in [BETAS].

notes.title: 20220429 Beta v2.2.7 Update
notes.notes:
Dear community,

We’re constantly working to improve your experience with Moon VR.
Here is what’s new in our latest version Beta V2.2.7:

[Improved]
180 video ratio issue fixed;
Manually switch codecs on Settings for better image quality.

How to download the Beta version of Moon VR?
1. Go to Steam 【LIBRARY】
2. 【Right-click】 Moon VR and select 【Properties】
3. Opt into【beta v2.2.6】 version in 【BETAS】
4. Close the window and wait for the download!


Please feel free to try out the latest version.
We look forward to your feedback!
Moon VR

notes.title: Moon VR Player Is Back & an Updated Beta Version Is Available
notes.notes:
Dear community,

Moon VR is back and we have finished an updated version for Steam!

To better prepare the version for public access, a closed beta version is now available to the users who have paid for the program before, totally free of charge! 

How to down Beta version of Moon VR?
1. Go to Steam 【LIBRARY】
2. 【Right-click】 Moon VR and select 【Properties】
3. Opt into 【beta】 version in 【BETAS】
4. Close the window and wait for the download

We do look forward to your feedback!
Feel free to join us at  Discord , or send your suggestions or issues to support@moonvrplayer.com.

Thank you for your support!
